items.summary: Running an independent post-production practice for brands, artists, and creators — owning edit, motion graphics, grade, and sound polish end to end.
highlights: Delivered 300+ edits across brand films, music videos, and creator content
Built reusable motion-graphics toolkits that keep client channels visually consistent
Managed full post pipelines solo: ingest, edit, grade, mix, master, delivery

items.summary: Led a small remote edit team producing weekly long-form and short-form content for a multi-channel creator network.
highlights: Set the house editing style: pacing rules, sound design library, title systems
Cut retention-focused edits that lifted average view duration across channels
Mentored two junior editors from raw-cut to publish-ready quality

items.summary: Cut social campaign videos and ad spots for consumer brands, learning the discipline of client rounds, deadlines, and delivery specs.
highlights: Turned around 15-second cutdowns and social variants at agency pace
Handled versioning and delivery across aspect ratios and platforms
Graduated from assembly cuts to owning full spots within a year

items.summary: Where FragTaco was born — cutting frag movies and gaming montages, learning sync, speed ramps, and sound design frame by frame.
highlights: Built an audience on gaming edits before it became the job
Learned the craft with zero budget and a stubborn amount of practice
